repo_skeleton.description: Go/Python main API service handling Auth, Orchestration, and CRUD.
OAuth2 + JWT implementation with RBAC and 2FA enforcement.
Vendor onboarding wizard logic with credential generation.
Python microservice for PDF OCR, parsing, and segmentation.
Container spec for parser service (includes Tesseract/LayoutLM).
Vector database interface and Strategist Agent logic.
UI component enforcing 2FA approval before export.
Terraform configuration for AWS Mumbai region.
Standard Operating Procedure for Legal Auditors.

openapi_yaml:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Sentinel Bharat API
  version: 1.0.0
servers:
  - url: https://api.sentinel.gov.in/v1
paths:
  /auth/token:
    post:
      summary: OAuth2 Token Endpoint
      description: Returns JWT access/refresh tokens. Enforces 2FA for Admin/Legal.
  /onboarding/register:
    post:
      summary: Vendor Registration
      description: Submits onboarding form data.
  /tenders/ingest:
    post:
      summary: Ingest Tender
      description: Upload PDF or Manual Entry. Triggers parsing job.
  /analysis/clause-map:
    get:
      summary: Get Parsed Clauses
      description: Returns identified clauses with categories.
  /prebid/draft:
    post:
      summary: Generate Draft
      description: Triggers Drafter Agent. Requires clause_id and strategy.
  /prebid/verify:
    post:
      summary: Verify Citations
      description: Double-blind check of generated citations against source.
  /legal/approve:
    post:
      summary: Legal Gate Approval
      description: Signs off on a draft/export. Requires 2FA signature.
  /export/package:
    post:
      summary: Generate Evidence Package
      description: Creates signed zip. BLOCKED if legal_approved=false.
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT

prompts.strategist:
ROLE: Senior Procurement Vigilance Officer (India).
TASK: Analyze the input Tender Clause text against the Knowledge Base (GFR 2017, CVC Circulars, Make in India Order).
OUTPUT: JSON object with keys: category, is_restrictive (bool), evidence_required (list), recommended_action (neutral/strict), confidence (0-1).
prompts.drafter:
ROLE: Defense Counsel for Vendor.
TASK: Draft a Pre-Bid Query based on the User's grievance regarding the specific clause.
RULES:
1. TONE: {STYLE} (concise/formal/officer_friendly).
2. CITE: You MUST cite specific sections of GFR/CVC/Acts provided in context. Format: [DocName#PageX: "snippet"].
3. FORBIDDEN: Do not invent laws. Do not suggest off-portal contact.
4. OBJECTIVE: Request amendment to allow fair competition.
prompts.verifier:
ROLE: Double-Blind Fact Checker.
TASK: Verify citations in the Input Draft against Source Documents.
STEPS:
1. Extract citations.
2. Find exact text in Source Document (fuzzy match threshold 0.95).
3. If verified, return status: VERIFIED.
4. If text missing or meaning distorted, return status: FAILED and block output.
OUTPUT: JSON verification report.

screens.layout: Split screen. Left: Branding/Gov logos. Right: Auth form with 2FA prompt.
Grid. Top: Metrics ticker. Main: Map view (verified only) vs List view.
Two-column. Left: PDF Viewer with canvas overlay. Right: Analysis stream & chat.
Table view. Rows: Pending Exports. Actions: Review, Approve (trigger 2FA), Reject.

    # Semantic segmentation logic stub
    clauses = segment_text(text)
    results = []
    for clause in clauses:
        txt_hash = hashlib.sha256(clause.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
        record = {

inline_code_snippets.dockerfiles:
# Parser Service
FROM python:3.9-slim
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y tesseract-ocr
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "service.py"]

# Frontend
FROM node:18-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json .
RUN npm install
COPY . .
RUN npm run build
CMD ["npm", "start"]
inline_code_snippets.terraform_skeleton:
# provider.tf
provider "aws" {
  region = "ap-south-1"
}

# vpc.tf
module "vpc" {
  source = "terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws"
  name = "sentinel-vpc"
  cidr = "10.0.0.0/16"
  azs = ["ap-south-1a", "ap-south-1b"]
  private_subnets = ["10.0.1.0/24", "10.0.2.0/24"]
  public_subnets  = ["10.0.101.0/24", "10.0.102.0/24"]
  enable_nat_gateway = true
}

# rds.tf
resource "aws_db_instance" "default" {
  allocated_storage    = 20
  engine               = "postgres"
  instance_class       = "db.t3.medium"
  name                 = "sentineldb"
  username             = var.db_username
  password             = var.db_password
  storage_encrypted    = true
  kms_key_id           = var.kms_key_arn
}
